name: pstack
description: Open-source port of Lauren Tan's pstack for Google Antigravity. Rigorous agent engineering workflows, 23 playbooks, 24 architectural principles, and multi-agent coordination with Antigravity native drop-in replacements.
suggestedPrompts: /poteto-mode to run a rigorous engineering playbook
/pstack-update to check for updates from GitHub and migrate config
/pstack-sync to compare against upstream pstack and wire in native Antigravity replacements
